definition: Training set is a dataset used to train a model.
details: Training set is a dataset used to train a model. Validation set is a dataset used to provide an unbiased evaluation of a model fit on the training dataset while tuning the model's hyperparameters. Test set is a dataset used to provide an unbiased evaluation of a final model fit on the training dataset.
